findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: golemreach_play · Private data: golemreach_connect, golemreach_look, golemreach_play, golemreach_frame · Public sink: golemreach_play · Destructive: golemreach_play.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: golemreach_play · Private data: golemreach_connect, golemreach_look, golemreach_play, golemreach_frame · Public sink: golemreach_play · Destructive: golemreach_play

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
